statement: Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result r, r = true if and only if Symmetric(root). Here Symmetric(t) holds iff either t = Null, or t = Node(v,l,r) and Mirror(l,r). The relation Mirror(a,b) holds iff either (a = Null and b = Null), or (a = Node(va,la,ra) and b = Node(vb,lb,rb) and va = vb and Mirror(la,rb) and Mirror(ra,lb)); in all other cases Mirror(a,b) is false.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree (a value of type Tree) with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000, where size(Null)=0 and size(Node(v,l,r))=1+size(l)+size(r), and every node value v satisfies -100 <= v <= 100.

statement: For every root satisfying the preconditions, is_symmetric(root) returns a result; it does not fail, overflow, access out of bounds, or panic.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000, where size(Null)=0 and size(Node(v,l,r))=1+size(l)+size(r), and every node value v satisfies -100 <= v <= 100.

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b, if b = true then size(root) is odd.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000, where size(Null)=0 and size(Node(v,l,r))=1+size(l)+size(r), and every node value v satisfies -100 <= v <= 100.

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(Node(v, Null, Null)) returns a result b, b = true.
preconditions: v is an integer with -100 <= v <= 100.

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b, b = false.
preconditions: root is exactly Node(v, l, Null) with l != Null, or exactly Node(v, Null, r) with r != Null; every node value is in [-100,100] and size(root) <= 1000, where size counts Node constructors.

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result bres, bres = true if and only if a = b.
preconditions: root = Node(v, Node(a, Null, Null), Node(b, Null, Null)) with -100 <= v <= 100, -100 <= a <= 100, and -100 <= b <= 100.

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(Node(v,l,r)) returns a result b1 and is_symmetric(Node(v',l,r)) returns a result b2, b1 = b2.
preconditions: l and r are finite trees, v and v' are integers, all node values in Node(v,l,r) and Node(v',l,r) are in [-100,100], and both trees have size at most 1000.

statement: Define mirrorTree(Null)=Null and mirrorTree(Node(v,l,r))=Node(v,mirrorTree(r),mirrorTree(l)). Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b1 and is_symmetric(mirrorTree(root)) returns a result b2, b1 = b2.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000 and every node value in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b, if b = true and root = Node(v,left,right), then size(left) = size(right), where size(Null)=0 and size(Node(u,l,r))=1+size(l)+size(r).
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000 and every node value in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b, if b = true and root = Node(v,left,right), then for every integer x, count(x,left) = count(x,right), where count(x,Null)=0 and count(x,Node(u,l,r)) = (if u=x then 1 else 0) + count(x,l) + count(x,r).
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000 and every node value in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b, if b = true then x = y.
preconditions: root = Node(v, Node(x,lx,rx), Node(y,ly,ry)), all node values are in [-100,100], and size(root) <= 1000.

statement: Define shift(c,Null)=Null and shift(c,Node(v,l,r))=Node(v+c,shift(c,l),shift(c,r)). Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b1 and is_symmetric(shift(c,root)) returns a result b2, b1 = b2.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000, where size(Null)=0 and size(Node(v,l,r))=1+size(l)+size(r), and every node value v satisfies -100 <= v <= 100; c is an integer such that v+c is in [-100,100] for every node value v of root.

statement: Define mirrorTree(Null)=Null and mirrorTree(Node(v,l,r))=Node(v,mirrorTree(r),mirrorTree(l)). Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b, b = true if and only if root = mirrorTree(root).
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000, where size(Null)=0 and size(Node(v,l,r))=1+size(l)+size(r), and every node value v satisfies -100 <= v <= 100.

statement: Define inorder(Null)=[] and inorder(Node(v,l,r))=inorder(l) ++ [v] ++ inorder(r). Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b, if b = true then inorder(root) = reverse(inorder(root)).
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000, where size(Null)=0 and size(Node(v,l,r))=1+size(l)+size(r), and every node value v satisfies -100 <= v <= 100.

statement: Whenever is_symmetric(root) returns a result b, if b = true then for every depth d >= 1, the number of nodes at depth d in root is even, where the root has depth 0 and the children of a node at depth d have depth d+1.
